description: This file defines a simple Android Activity class named GraphicsActivity, which conditionally wraps the content view in a custom layout if a testing flag is set.

classes.name: GraphicsActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that conditionally wraps its content view in a PictureLayout for testing purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, calling the superclass method.

methods.name: setContentView
methods.description: Sets the activity's content view; wraps in a PictureLayout if the TEST_PICTURE flag is true.
